topic: The Logic of Abstract Vector Spaces

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: From Arrows to Rules
lecture_lines: Vectors are arrows with length and direction.
animations: Create a 2D arrow at grid B4 (length 2, 45deg, #FF5733) with.
Animate vector stretching to length 3, 60deg; change color to #33FF57.
Transition vector into a Dot at grid B5 (#3357FF) with.

sections.title: The Generalization Leap
lecture_lines: A vector space is a collection of objects.
animations: Display a vector Arrow icon at D3 (#FF5733).
Morph Arrow into a Function curve f(x) at B3-B4 (#33FF57).
Morph Function symbol into quadratic Polynomial ax²+bx+c at E3-E4 (#3357FF).

sections.title: Application: The Library of Sounds
lecture_lines: Each time point is a dimension.
Adding clips creates a new sound.
animations: Draw audio wave signal at C2 (#FF5733), emerging from.
Display 'Bass' (#33FF57) at B4-B5 and 'Treble' (#3357FF) at C4-C5 signal vector waveforms.
Animate vector sum (superimposed wave) at D4 (#FF33FF) overlaying.

sections.title: Core Constraints: The Axiomatic DNA
lecture_lines: Spaces must pass the stress test.
Closure requires staying within the set.
Sum of vectors must be inside.
animations: Perform polynomial addition inside container; glow green if result stays inside (#33FF57).
Perform invalid addition leaving set; flash container red at E1 (#FF3333).

sections.title: Conclusion: The Power of Abstraction
lecture_lines: Data points obey these same rules.
animations: Rapid zoom-out revealing cloud of data points at B3-E5 (#3357FF).
Fade in lattice grid connecting points (#FFFFFF).
